purpose: Finish every source-custody step that can be completed without fabricating human adjudication or model-evaluation evidence, then stop cleanly at the human-gold boundary.
required_actions: For all six frozen selection cases, retrieve the exact bounded passage bytes only from the verified TEST_ONLY public-domain source route.
Record a stable source locator and compute SHA-256 over the exact bounded passage bytes supplied to later inference/adjudication.
Verify each case still belongs to its frozen work and named stress slice; passage replacement is allowed only for documented source defect, rights defect or adjudication impossibility.
Create adjudication packet shells containing provenance, locator, source digest, task family, ambiguity fields and adjudicator slots but no fabricated gold labels or adjudication notes.

Preserve raw source bodies and bounded passage text outside durable repository evidence unless a separate rights/custody decision explicitly allows storage; repository evidence should use locators/digests/nonreconstructive metadata.
Do not run scoring and do not claim model quality before human gold and prediction-freeze evidence exist.
pass_proves: The six frozen public-domain held-out cases are source-custody-ready for real human adjudication without selection leakage or provenance ambiguity.
pass_does_not_prove: AGLO manuscript mutation, baseline promotion, publication or canon authority
pass_unlocks: BLOCKED — HUMAN: obtain required independent adjudication under HUMAN-ADJUDICATION-PACKET-CONTRACT-v1, freeze model predictions with gold hidden, then score Candidate-002.
on_failure: Repair only the failing source route, rights/provenance, locator or digest boundary. Do not substitute a different passage because a model performs better on it and do not weaken TEST_ONLY isolation.
a01_reason: This gate is bounded source-custody and metadata preparation; no runner-specific evidence or long execution delta is required.
do_not: Do not expose gold to the model backend.
Do not commit bulk copyrighted or unnecessary full-text bodies.
Do not transfer hosted or A-01 authority from another SHA.
Do not mutate canonical narrative state or AGLO manuscript content.
